dataset.method: AutoPASS-regulativ for ferjetakster from 2026-01-01 (Statens vegvesen, set by the Ministry of Transport): the full price per crossing by zone and the vehicle's total length with trailer and load (AP1 up to 6 m ... AP6 14.51-17.5 m, AP7 17.51-19.5 m, AP8 19.51-22 m, AP9 over 22 m); the table includes 12% VAT, the prices here exclude it. Paying by AutoPASS tag with a prepaid business ferry account (`etc`) takes 40% off (a central AutoPASS agreement alone, 10%). Zero-emission trucks (CO2 class 5; the regulativ: registered with fuel code 5, electric, or 6, hydrogen, in the Norwegian register, or for a foreign one in AutoPASS's own routine, else full price) pay 70% (AP1) or 50% (AP2-AP9) of their group's price, to the krone, and the discounts apply on that. Each national road ferry route's zone by stretch from the Minister of Transport's answer to the Storting of 11 December 2025 (written question 699), checked against the table; the quays from NVDB, matched where a route goes out on OpenStreetMap's car ferry line from them. Moss-Horten has a regulativ of its own: the operator's price list from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31, by length (AP4 10.01-12 m, AP5 12.01-14 m, AP6 14.01-17.5 m), 30% off with a prepaid Moss-Horten agreement (`etc`), its electric and hydrogen prices for zero-emission trucks, double for vehicles wider than 2.6 m (not applied). Mortavika–Arsvågen: the toll (bompenger) charged on board isn't included. Skipavik–Hjelmeland is free (priced 0 in the Minister's table). Skipavik–Nesvik is free (priced 0 in the Minister's table). Balestrand–Dragsvik: OpenStreetMap has no car ferry line from Balestrand, so it isn't priced. Balestrand–Hella: OpenStreetMap has no car ferry line from Balestrand, so it isn't priced. Balestrand–Vangsnes: OpenStreetMap has no car ferry line from Balestrand, so it isn't priced. Bodø–Røst is free (priced 0 in the Minister's table). Bodø–Værøy is free (priced 0 in the Minister's table). Moskenes–Røst is free (priced 0 in the Minister's table). Moskenes–Værøy is free (priced 0 in the Minister's table). Værøy–Røst is free (priced 0 in the Minister's table).
